alterations.description: Shots of Goan Police dashing head of Shekhar's mother against the pole are reduced.
The word 'Bitch' spoken by Ronte to Juie is deleted.
Shots of beheading of Goan soldiers with sword by Ramdas are deleted.
Shots of molestation of Laju by Ronte are reduced to a suggestion.
Shots of Laju and Manhar kissing in a song dance sequence are reduced.
Shots of blood oozing from the mouth of Bhima are deleted.
Shots of Bhima and Laju rolling over in molestation sequence are deleted.

The entire sequence of horses tearing apart the hands and legs of Gopi's father, including the intercuts of the sadistic laughter and distorted faces of the villain and his henchmen, is deleted, retaining only the visual of hands and legs being tied to the horses and the man lying on the ground without hands and legs.
Lashing and chasing of Gopi Nagappa's henchmen is reduced by 50%.
Fighting is reduced by 50%.
The entire sequence of pumpkins being crushed by horses, accompanied by the sadistic laughter by the villain and his men, is deleted.
Fighting is reduced by 50%.
The visual of the severed head of Nagappa on the ground is reduced to a flash.
The words 'first night' uttered by Viji to the married couple are deleted.
Visuals of kissing of Rani by Bharathan against the words 'Ennamo panradhu' are deleted.
Close visuals of Rani in wet clothes jerking of bust are deleted.
Visuals of Rani and Bharathan lying on the haystack are deleted.
Visual of dwarf removing his banian is deleted.
Visuals of Rani and Bharathan near the pole and he slapping against her hip are deleted.
Words of Paramasivam to his daughter from 'Appave moodlyirundha' to 'avasiyam irukkadhilla' are deleted.
In the sequence where Sankar is being attacked by the villains, all shots of Sankar being hit with sticks after he has fallen on the ground and also the shots of villain stamping on him are deleted.
The shot of the Inspector with blood-stained face after the accident is reduced to a flash.

The following dialogues spoken by Sanyas to the girl are deleted: 'light weight movement...to Untundhi anuko.', 'Rathri poota...to Upayaogapaduthundi. Pagali jeevitham pagatidhi, raathri jeevitham rathridi...double shift- double payment.', 'Tarvata cee ammayini vaariki ivvandhi.'
In the fighting sequence, the shot of Basavil stamping on Sanyasi's throat is deleted.
The close shot of Sanyasi's blood-stained face when it is turned is reduced.
The shots of Basava and Parvaihi stamping on the face of the hired thug are deleted.
The shots of the child hanging from the ceiling are reduced to the first and the last shot when he falls into the hands of Basava.
In the song sequence, the visuals of Daisy lying over Naycodran and the latter putting his legs over her are deleted.
The visuals of exposed breasts of Daisy as she bends forward to pick up the glass are deleted.
The scene where the brothel madam is beaten by the goons and the dialogue after picking up the telephone are deleted.
The dialogue of rowdies referring to Rekha 'Bandu manishi condition to Undi - body mundu venaka kooda bagano unde guru - start chesi choodameniti' is deleted.
Jamadar's dialogue 'Kotlama Ankhi Raat' with his vulgar gesture is deleted.
Nagji's dialogue 'Ane Toofani Ghodipur rany weling sewar tho thawaao An Anun aves evasar An Nagji chukwn nathi aangto' is deleted.
The molestation of Radha by Nagji on the cart is drastically reduced (80% to 90%).
The merciless beating of Jithro by Nagji is drastically reduced (80% to 90%).
Plunging of knife to man's stomach is reduced to a suggestion only.
The word 'RANDI' is deleted.
The word 'Chinal' is deleted.
The scene of molestation is reduced.
The scene of a rod stained with blood in Kundan's stomach is deleted.
